messages:
Liam: Heads-up: traveling to Austin next month for a week of meetings. Any breakfast tacos near the office (2-3 blocks from 6th & Congress)?
Asha: Torchy's is ok but chains. For real local vibes hit Veracruz All Natural on the east side. AMAZING migas taco.
Noelle: Veracruz truck has lines but moves fast. Also Taco 'Ritas on 5th has great barbacoa.
Darren: Spot called Veracruz All Natural 33 1704 E 6th St (truck/or stand) and Torchy's 33 2800 S Lamar (chain).
Liam: Is Veracruz walkable from downtown?
Asha: It's a short ride (~8-10 mins). Walkable if you like 20-25 min.
Noelle: Also for coffee + tacos try Once Over Coffee for breakfast sandwiches.
Liam: Solid. Any red flags for dietary/vegetarian options?
Darren: Lots of veggie options; they do cactus and potato tacos.
FoodBot: Note: some trucks take cash only. Carry small bills.
Liam: Thanks! I'll save this for the trip. Anyone want a postcard? :postcard:
_meta: Austin breakfast tacos recs and travel chat
